definitions.gamma_common_pair: d_1 - d_0 with d_r = mean over replicates of MASE(sequence) - MASE(summary), same donor kind, same pair at both r
definitions.gamma_factorial: fusion effect at r=1 minus at r=0, each the balanced 2 x 2 average; NOT_ESTIMABLE unless the 2 x 2 exists at both r
definitions.readout: last-step readout minus pooled readout, per fusion and balanced; descriptive at the r where it exists
definitions.donor_delta: (sequence_dsum - summary_dsum) - (sequence - summary) per replicate: the SAME common pair with the other donor
definitions.H2: profiles minus the mean of ALL random redistributions of the replicate; every control required

bootstrap_note: percentile intervals from resampling 2 replicate ids with replacement, same estimator as the point; with 2 replicates this is a description of two observations, not population precision, equivalence or power
